entries.rationale: Highest-leverage efficiency lever: bare tool names, schema removed from context. bypassPermissions makes the deny globs call-time safety only.

Deny the native tools the yf-* skills forbid (native plan mode, Task*, notebook/design/report surfaces, schedulers) plus call-time rm -rf safety globs. Union-only: never removes an operator's existing denies. Agent is deliberately absent — every yf coordinator fans out through it.
bypassPermissions companion: without it the dangerous-mode prompt still interrupts long autonomous runs.
yf-* skills parallelize via the Agent tool; native workflow/task tools are forbidden. disable*=true means the capability is off.
bd (beads) is the ONLY task tracker. TodoWrite / markdown checklists / inline task lists are forbidden by every beads-backed skill contract.
Portability: yf state must be cross-harness (beads / incubators / repo files). Native Claude memory traps it in a Claude-only store.
Same portability contract — any Claude-native persistence traps yf state in a non-portable store.
Same portability contract. All state lives in vault/repo files; never session-only or Claude-only stores.
Data minimization — keep state off Anthropic's servers.
The yf-* skills rely on description-based triggering; a bundled skill whose description overlaps a yf-* trigger can shadow it.
Fewer interruptions — notification noise on long runs.
